sum: GOWell Energy Technology provides integrated wireline logging technology and solutions that focuses on advancing well evaluation, integrity, and performance. It delivers equipment, logging data interpretation, and repair and maintenance services. The company serves the full energy spectrum, including oil and gas, geothermal, underground storage, and carbon sequestration across the asset lifecycle, from construction and production to rejuvenation and permanent abandonment. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Singapore.
ceo: Mr. Guillaume Louis Andre Borrel (CEO & Director)
